newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower as Asian values remain weak.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower as Asian values remain weak.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower in thin dealings with the discount noted in Asian rice values limiting upside potential for U.S. rice prices, traders said.
"PL480 business has been spoken for and the Thai market and other Asian values are drastically under the U.S. values," a trader said.
Rice futures volume according to the CBOT was estimated at 500 contracts, up from 357 Thursday.
Rice futures closed three to seven cents per cwt lower, with November down three at $9.90 per cwt.
